_doc: Budget for the merchant admin Worker (ebda-admin, OpenNext), enforced by `scripts/ci/worker-startup-budget.mjs --app admin` (CI: Worker dry-run (admin)). Same method and caveats as worker-startup-budget.json (API): local-workerd CPU, NOT Cloudflare's, regression gates with headroom, raise only with a Ruling. Bundle = health-worker-entry.js (the generated entry the deploy uses; it wraps the OpenNext worker). The absolute CPU ceiling runs on main/nightly; PRs compare against main built in the same job (relative).
_ruling: Ruling ADMIN-STARTUP-BUDGET-1 (QA-PERF-LOGIN-1 (b), 2026-11-18): the admin Worker had no startup/bundle budget. First measurement (7 runs, local workerd, min of samples, first sample 34.6 ms): 20.7 ms startup CPU, 19.70 MB raw / 3.55 MB gzip. Ceilings: ~3x CPU, ~10% size headroom.
